card.name: Suicidal thoughts boxed warning heading
card.fires_on: The word AND, or the split-off O in THOUGHTS, inside the all-caps boxed warning heading "SUICIDAL THOUGHTS AND BEHAVIORS".

modes.label: AND after THOUGHTS
modes.description: The word AND right after SUICIDAL THOUGHTS in the boxed warning title.
modes.example: WARNING: SUICIDAL THOUGHTS<< AND>> BEHAVIORS Antidepressants increased

modes.label: Inside THOUGHTS
modes.description: The letter O in the split-up word TH-O-UGHTS in the same heading.
modes.example: WARNING: SUICIDAL TH<<O>>UGHTS AND BEHAVIORS Ant

card.writes: It pushes toward word-starts like mem and bel and away from memory and thoughts words, so it adds little clear meaning.
card.plain: It lights up inside the all-caps antidepressant warning title about suicidal thoughts and behaviors.
